name: credential-file
title: Provider credential file: review copy
for_each: select id,code,name from providers order by code

sections.title: Practitioner
sections.sql: select code,name,jurisdiction,profession,owner from providers where id=$1

sections.title: Credentials and source checks
sections.sql: select code,kind,reference,issued_on,expires_on,evidence_ref,checked_on,verification_result,verification_source,verifier from credential_register where provider_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Site decisions
sections.sql: select code,status,starts_on,ends_on,scope_review_ref,decision_ref,decision_by,decision_at from appointments where provider_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: A record of operator decisions. Not a practising certificate or authority to practise.

name: renewal-request
title: Draft credential evidence request
for_each: select distinct p.id,p.code,p.name from providers p join credentials c on c.provider_id=p.id where p.active and c.expires_on<=CURRENT_DATE+60

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: select code,kind,reference,expires_on,evidence_ref from credentials where provider_id=$1 and expires_on<=CURRENT_DATE+60 order by expires_on
sections.note: Check the live register and request updated evidence through your approved process. This draft has not been sent.

name: appointment-review
title: Draft site appointment review
for_each: select id,code from appointments order by code

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select appointment,provider,site,kind,expires_on,checked_on,verification_result,finding from appointment_checks where appointment_id=$1 order by kind

sections.title: Recorded decision
sections.note: Human review of scope, conditions and primary sources remains required.
